svg.title: Then bk →0, Mbk is invertible eventually, and (PT6) gives the exact determining equations in the interacting mean hierarchy. Equality of (PT3) with those measured equations follows by expanding the inserted labels in the finite basis and exchanging a finite sum with the integrable profile. For any other finite collection R of such separated profiles, continuity of CR and convergence (wR(k), bk) → (w0 R, 0) give CR(wR(k), bk) −→CR(w0 R, 0). (PT8)
